signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Enter your work e-mail address. We will send you a six-digit code.

sent.title: Check your e-mail
sent.body: If that address has an account, a six-digit code is on its way. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
sent.resend: Did not get it? Start again.

code.invalid: That code is not right. {attempts} attempts left.
code.expired: That code has expired. Start again.
code.exhausted: Too many attempts on that code. Start again.
code.locked: Too many sign-in attempts for this address. Try again in 24 hours.
code.missing: Enter the six digits from the e-mail.

approve.title: Approve this device?
approve.intro: A device asked to sign in to your account.
approve.warning: Only continue if you just started a sign-in on that device.
approve.codeIntro: Type the code shown on the device you are signing in.
approve.unknownCode: That code is not valid any more. Start the sign-in again on the device.

approved.title: Device approved
approved.body: Go back to the device. It finishes signing in on its own.

denied.title: Sign-in denied
denied.body: Nothing was approved. You can close this page.

signedOut.title: Signed out
signedOut.body: Your sign-in on this browser has ended. You will be asked for your e-mail and a code next time.

error.title: Cannot continue
error.generic: Something went wrong. Close this page and start again.
error.invalidClient: This sign-in link is not valid. Start again from the app.
error.invalidRedirect: This sign-in link is not valid. Start again from the app.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

reason.tenant_inactive: Your provider's account is not active. Contact support.
reason.seat_cap_reached: No seats left in your organisation.
reason.device_revoked: This device was signed out by an admin.
reason.session_revoked: You were signed out. Please sign in again.
reason.refresh_reused: Signed out for security. Please sign in again.
reason.refresh_expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
reason.device_code_expired: The code expired. Start sign-in again.
reason.invalid_grant: That sign-in could not be completed. Start again.
reason.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

footer.note: Never share a sign-in code with anyone.
